verse.verse_1: A requester seeks the punishment that will take place –
verse.verse_2: - Upon the disbelievers – the punishment that none can avert.
verse.verse_3: From Allah, the Lord of all pinnacles.
verse.verse_4: The angels and Jibreel, ascend towards Him – the punishment will befall on a day which spans fifty thousand years.
verse.verse_5: Therefore patiently endure, in the best manner (O dear Prophet Mohammed – peace and blessings be upon him).
verse.verse_6: They deem it to be remote.
verse.verse_8: The day when the sky will be like molten silver.
verse.verse_9: And the hills will be light as wool.
verse.verse_10: And no friend will ask concerning his friend.
verse.verse_11: They will be seeing them; the guilty will wish if only he could redeem himself from the punishment of that day, by offering his sons.
verse.verse_12: And his wife and his brother.
verse.verse_13: And the family in which he was.
verse.verse_14: And all those who are in the earth – then only if the redemption saves him!
verse.verse_15: Never! That is indeed a blazing fire.
verse.verse_16: A fire that melts the hide.
verse.verse_17: It calls out to him who reverted and turned away.
verse.verse_18: And accumulated wealth and hoarded it.
verse.verse_19: Indeed man is created very impatient, greedy.
verse.verse_20: Very nervous when touched by misfortune.
verse.verse_21: And refraining, when good reaches him.
verse.verse_23: Those who are regular in their prayers.
verse.verse_24: And those in whose wealth exists a recognised right,
verse.verse_25: For those who beg, and for the needy who cannot even ask.
verse.verse_26: And those who believe the Day of Judgement to be true.
verse.verse_27: And those who fear the punishment of their Lord.
verse.verse_28: Indeed the punishment of their Lord is not a thing to be unafraid of!
verse.verse_29: And those who protect their private organs (from adultery).
verse.verse_30: Except with their wives and the bondwomen in their possession, for there is no reproach on them.
verse.verse_31: So those who desire more than this – it is they who are the transgressors.
verse.verse_32: And those who protect the property entrusted to them, and their agreements.
verse.verse_33: And those who are firm upon their testimonies.
verse.verse_34: And those who protect their prayers.
verse.verse_35: It is these who will be honoured in Gardens.
verse.verse_36: So what is the matter with these disbelievers, that they stare at you (O dear Prophet Mohammed – peace and blessings be upon him)?
verse.verse_37: From the right and the left, in groups?
verse.verse_38: Does every man among them aspire to be admitted into the Garden of serenity?
verse.verse_39: Never! We have indeed created them from a thing they know.
verse.verse_40: So I swear by the Lord of every East and every West, that We are indeed Able.
verse.verse_41: To replace them by those better than them; and none can escape from Us.
verse.verse_42: Therefore leave them, involved in their indecencies and play, till they confront their day which they are promised.
verse.verse_43: A day when they will come out of the graves in haste, as if rushing towards their goals.
verse.verse_44: With lowered eyes, disgrace overcoming them; this is the day, which they had been promised.
